The /list/{user_id} route is kept for backward compatibility but /list is preferred.

Handle chat messages from embedded widget.

Features:
- Origin validation against allowed domains
- Rate limiting (20 RPM default, aligned with OpenAI free tier)
- Flow-based agent support (GraphExecutor)
- Simple agent support (Agno Agent with knowledge)
- Session persistence
- Billing to agent owner

Streaming chat endpoint with async billing.

Uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream response chunks.
Billing is pushed to async queue for ultra-low latency.

Event types:
- content: Response text chunk
- done: Final message with session_id and metrics
- error: Error message

Returns full agent details with nested model, voice, transcriber,

Only provided fields are updated.

Delete an agent.

This permanently removes the agent and all associated data.

post.description:
Create a chat completion with an agent.

Supports both streaming (SSE) and non-streaming responses.
Enforces billing based on token usage.

Create a voice session with an AI agent.

Returns a LiveKit token for WebRTC connection.
The agent bot is automatically dispatched to the room.

Authentication: Bearer token (JWT or Platform API Key)

End a voice session by session ID.

Deletes the room and marks the session as ended.

get.description: Health check for voice service.

post.description:
Start a new voice session with an AI agent.

Creates a LiveKit room and returns connection details.
The agent bot should be started separately via the worker.
End a voice session and terminate the LiveKit room.

get.description: Get voice session status.
List voice sessions with recordings and analytics.

Get detailed info about a voice session including transcript and per-turn latency metrics.

Admins bypass the ownership check so the admin dashboard's Voice tab can
open the same sidesheet (with transcript/recording/sentiment) for any
tenant's session. Non-admins still restricted to their own sessions.
List all phone numbers for current user with pagination.

get.description:
Get agent's voice configuration for the bot.
Requires authentication via JWT or API key (thns_sk_...).
Returns voice_config, system_prompt, and tools for the agent.
Get dynamic phone number pricing from database.

delete.description:
Release/Delete a phone number.

This will:
1. If Twilio, release from Twilio
2. If Vobiz (Purchased), release from Vobiz
3. Delete LiveKit SIP resources (Trunk, Dispatch Rule)
4. Mark as deleted in database

post.description: Validate user's Twilio credentials and return their phone numbers. Stores credentials on success.
Import a phone number from user's own Twilio account (BYOK). Sets up SIP trunks and routing.

Initiate an outbound call using a configured phone number.

Terminate an outbound call.

Returns a combined list with provider info, preview URLs, and native language scripts.
